html:
On 15 March 2019 a white supremacist gunman attacked two mosques in Christchurch, New Zealand, during Friday prayers, killing 51 people. He streamed the attack live online.

Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern, who wore a headscarf to meet the families, won praise for her response. Within a month parliament banned most semi-automatic guns, as Australia had done after Port Arthur.

She and France's president launched the Christchurch Call to curb terrorist content online. The attacker was jailed for life without parole. The city had already been hit by the 2011 earthquake. See Islam.
sum: On 15 March 2019 a white supremacist gunman attacked two mosques in Christchurch, New Zealand, during Friday prayers, killing 51 people. He streamed the attack live online.
